prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1151
Claimant:
Megan Patterson
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
June 30, 2023
First notice of loss received for a collision at an intersection where the insured vehicle was turning left and was struck
by an oncoming vehicle. The claimant reports neck pain and has not retained counsel.
July 23, 2023
Recorded a recorded statement from the claimant describing the approach, the signal phase, and the moment of
impact. The account is consistent with the initial report.
August 29, 2023
Reviewed photographs supplied by the claimant, which confirm the general position of the vehicles and several
details of the damage. No independent witnesses have come forward to date.
September 7, 2023
Estimate of damage to the vehicle is mostly in line with the impact described, with the damage concentrated on the
front and side areas expected for this type of collision. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or
inspection records.
September 30, 2023
Police report and statements from other parties confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the incident.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before the policy coverage began.
December 6, 2023
Claimant reports neck strain. The reported injury fits the kind and force of the crash well. Medical records were
requested and the claimant signed authorization for release.
December 14, 2023
Medical file shows treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved. The claimant
disclosed a small strain to the same area several years ago that healed fully, and that history has been noted.
December 22, 2023
Claimant later added a few small details to the account during a follow-up call, but the core description of events
stayed the same as in the original statement.
January 7, 2024
Confirmed the driver involved lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member under the policy. File
reviewed and remains open pending final medical summary.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
